comingLast.roast: tied at the bottom with Bowling - back nines will decide who takes them home
5 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
3 holes between him and a very memorable presso
needs 2 to escape - the most supported man on the course right now
tied with Jones - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
done, 1 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
1 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
2 above Jones from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
done and 3 above the drop - his interest in Jones's round is intense and personal
in on 3 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
